'''Fire arrow''' is an early game [[:Category:Arrows|arrow]]. It is useful against several enemies in both the [[Meadows]] and the [[Black Forest]] biomes which fear or are weak to fire. 

== Availability ==

* Crafted at a [[Workbench]]
* Found in chests in [[Abandoned House]]s, buried in [[Viking Graveyard]] and inside [[Burial Chambers]]

== Features ==

* Deals both [[fire]] and [[pierce]] damage, applying the [[burning]] DOT effect.
* [[Wet Effect|Wet]] enemies (indicated by dripping water) will extinguish the burning quickly, causing very little damage.
* Provides ambient lighting when fired on dry surfaces.
* When fired on surfaces that are underwater, fire arrows will be extinguished and will not provide any ambient lighting. However, if fired onto an initially dry surface, and it goes underwater (e.g. waves rolling in on shorelines), fire arrows will remain lit.

However, frost arrows' damage primarily comes from their [[Damage#Frost|frost]] effect, with pierce damage being the lesser.


== Availability ==
* [[Freeze Gland]]s are found within the [[Mountain]] [[Biomes|biome]] by killing [[Drake]]s.
* [[Obsidian]] can be found within the [[Mountain]] [[Biomes|biome]].
* Frost arrows can occasionally be found in chests from ruins in the [[Mountain]] [[Biomes|biome]].


== Features ==
* Deals damage divided between frost and [[Damage#Pierce|pierce]] damage. 
* Applies a [[Frost Effect|slowing effect]] that is particularly useful against smaller enemies like [[Fuling]]s.

Its primary attack is a 3 hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 3x damage.
